draft.subject: A first project in Wrenfield, start to finish
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Following up on our onboarding call last week -- I know new tools can slip down the list in a busy week, so no worries if Wrenfield has been on hold.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so getting one project going is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and I'm glad to walk it with you.

Would a 15-minute call this week work? Send me a time that suits you and I'll set it up.

Best,
Priya
